name: Hammer vs. Screwdriver
instruction: Create a 3D model of both a hammer and a screwdriver. The hammer should have a claw end and a flat end, with a handle. The screwdriver should have a flat tip and a handle. Compare the two tools in terms of their shapes and functionalities.

Shape accuracy: The hammer has a claw end and a flat end.
The handle of the hammer is cylindrical.
The screwdriver has a flat tip.
The handle of the screwdriver is also cylindrical.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The hammer's head is larger than the handle.
The screwdriver's tip is smaller than the handle.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The hammer's claw end and flat end are positioned correctly.
The handle of the hammer is securely attached to the head.
The screwdriver's flat tip is aligned with its handle.
The handle of the screwdriver is properly balanced.
Object distance and contact: There is no overlap between the hammer's head and handle.
The screwdriver's tip does not overlap with the handle.
Both tools have distinct separation in their design.

Instruction execution accuracy: Both tools are accurately represented as per the instructions.
The functionalities of each tool are clearly defined.
